primary_sources.title: BMC for Weak Memory Models: Relation Analysis for Compact SMT Encodings
primary_sources.claim: May/active event-pair fixpoints are property/axiom-driven; top-down demands trigger bottom-up analysis; Andersen alias narrows rf/co candidates. Generic static dependency pruning is prior art.

primary_sources.title: Static Analysis of Memory Models for SMT Encodings
primary_sources.read_scope: Sections1–2, Section5 relevant substitution/acyclicity/thinning discussion, Section6 evaluation; abstract semantics formal rules not completely audited
primary_sources.claim: External analyses through filters, execution-relative may/must bounds and control-flow implications support equisatisfiable substitution, acyclicity reduction and thinning. Existing advanced Dartagnan analyses must be included as close neighbors.

primary_sources.title: Bounded Model Checking of Multi-threaded C Programs via Lazy Sequentialization
primary_sources.read_scope: Sections1–3, bounded cloning and creation/local-state/join preservation mechanism
primary_sources.claim: Unwound creation occurrences get separate function copies; per-instance persistent locals and real thread creation/completion are not new algorithms.

primary_sources.title: Concurrent Program Verification with Lazy Sequentialization and Interval Analysis
primary_sources.read_scope: Sections1–3, Section4 experiment design and Section5 related work
primary_sources.claim: Lazy sequentialization preserves reachable bounded states; Frama-C computes overapproximation intervals; variable types narrowed to CBMC bitvectors. Numerical AI-assisted concurrent BMC has a direct original predecessor.

primary_sources.title: Partial Orders for Efficient Bounded Model Checking of Concurrent Software
primary_sources.read_scope: Sections1–3 and relevant beginning of Section4; not full paper/proof appendix
primary_sources.claim: SSA per thread plus partial-order rf/write-serialization encodings prove bounded-model execution correspondence and process spawning; clocks/partial orders not new by themselves.

primary_sources.title: Interpretation-Based Violation Witness Validation for C: NITWIT
primary_sources.read_scope: PDF pp1-4 and7-8, definitions and interpreter/assumption behavior
primary_sources.claim: Independent interpretation and witness-conditioned concrete execution are prior art; sequential reachability setting differs from pthread race prefixes.

primary_sources.title: Violation Witnesses and Result Validation for Multi-Threaded Programs
primary_sources.claim: Concrete thread identity/create mapping and witness-restricted control/value validation already exist; 2020 implementation discusses optional hints and unresolved thread-scoped assumptions.

primary_sources.title: Dartagnan: SMT-based Violation Witness Validation
primary_sources.claim: Encoding verification conjoined with witness constraints is prior art; section3 explicitly admits accepting nonviolating witness paths when control-flow witness information is omitted. Current later versions must be audited separately.

primary_sources.title: Differentially Testing Soundness and Precision of Program Analyzers
primary_sources.read_scope: PDF pp1-2 and4-6, sectionsIII-IV andV.C selected paragraphs
primary_sources.claim: Automated variant generation/multi-analyzer differential testing with heuristic vs confirmed distinctions is prior art; current project manual own-tool fixtures do not establish a new test method.

primary_sources.title: Alive2: Bounded Translation Validation for LLVM
primary_sources.claim: Per-run validation reducing whole-system proof burden is prior art; Alive2 checks intraprocedural transformation refinement including UB, not concurrent witness truth. AR replay currently trusts frontend/snapshot and is not translation validation.

primary_sources.title: Interrogation Testing of Program Analyzers for Soundness and Precision Issues
primary_sources.read_scope: PDF pp1-2 and5-8, sections1-2,3.3,4 selected implementation/minimization paragraphs and5.1
primary_sources.claim: General interrogation testing uses more than Boolean response plus persistent query knowledge base; assumption/assertion transformations have set-inclusion/equality oracles. Current hand-built certificate mutations do not establish a new testing framework.

primary_sources.title: Constraint-Based Test Oracles for Program Analyzers
primary_sources.read_scope: PDF pp1-2 and4-5, sections1,3.1-3.3 throughinteger/bit-vector conversion
primary_sources.claim: Minotaur generates C ground-truth safe/unsafe programs from satisfiable/unsatisfiable SMT constraints; a generic proposal for SAT-based oracle generation is already covered. Concurrent execution-instance and HB/rf contracts would require specific novel mechanism.

primary_sources.title: Interrogation Testing of CHC Solvers
primary_sources.read_scope: PDF pp1-3 and5-6 selected transformation categories, section1/severity table andearly4
primary_sources.claim: Explicitly distinguishes correct Sat/Unsat verdict with wrong models/refutation proofs (severity3); uses witness-generated transformations plus knowledge base. Abstract domain-independent approach and wrong-certificate observation are prior art. Concurrent certificate tests need genuinely different obligations and transformations.

candidate_assessments.title: Provenance-Guided Reconstruction of Race Executions
candidate_assessments.implemented_seed: Selected occurrence bindings, MAY byte/context/history information, 28-check constructed auxiliary replay; no automatic effectful auxiliary SMT generation.
candidate_assessments.nearest_work_axes: Program-prefix/source/termination reconstruction vs CAT relation simplification and ordinary full bounded unfolding; novelty not established.
proofs_needed: Accepted closure model extends to a legal finite race prefix, including definedness/API/lifetime and all synchronization.
Under complete MAY dependencies and explicit omission premises, related bounded executions project/extend; stronger than accepted-witness validity.
first_decisive_experiments: SMT-generated effectful auxiliary completion plus full-join, wrong-source/instance/guard/HB controls.
Same multi-trace semantics and bounds: full finite universe allowing unscheduled threads vs syntactic+cheap alias closure vs IKOS byte/context/history guidance.
no_go: Richer AI yields the same closure/cost as simple analysis.
Gains only reflect new semantics or increased bounds/resources.
Nearest method already covers the same increment.

candidate_assessments.title: Effect-Scoped Precision Refinement for Concurrent Heap Analysis
candidate_assessments.implemented_seed: Byte footprint/unknown-effect gates, dirty invalidation and restricted publication/lifetime certificates.
candidate_assessments.nearest_work_axes: Target refinement-specific complete byte/representation/escape envelope and conservative local invalidation; compare PBR/cluster/digest/ownership instead of renaming these methods.
proofs_needed: Complete possible-effect coverage including APIs/threads/representation writes and fallback TOP.
Sound relational instance/lifetime abstraction, transfer/join/widening and stable global post-fixpoint.
first_decisive_experiments: Separating source/IR example of actual relation loss vs nearest full method.
Matched contracts: global sticky gate, local footprint mechanism and appropriate region/shape baseline; unseen concurrent C families.
no_go: Collection of syntax certificates rather than a general mechanism.
Incomplete global coverage or discarded unknown effects.

candidate_assessments.title: Contract-Guided Testing of Concurrent Execution Evidence
candidate_assessments.implemented_seed: 143 selected AR prefixes checked and manual semantic corruption controls; runtime verdict validation not integrated.
candidate_assessments.nearest_work_axes: Concurrent actual create/return/HB/byte-rf and proven joint program/certificate transformations; ordinary witness-driven interrogation already exists.
proofs_needed: Acceptance implies a valid violation in the declared semantics.
Preserving/breaking transformations and reduction preserve their respective permitted-execution oracles.
Standard set-valued witness and exact exported-prefix contracts remain distinct.
first_decisive_experiments: Second independent producer and fixed format contracts.
Cross-tool original/transformed paired evidence with random mutation and Sherlock/Minotaur/HornGator methods as pertinent controls.
no_go: Different model or legal optional hints misreported as unsound validator acceptance.
Generic interrogation/constraint-based generation merely ported to pthread input.
